summary: Iteration 15: Testing Excel Mapping tab in Balia admin panel (/admin/prices/balia). Fixed critical SelectItem empty value bug. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed critical bug: SelectItem with empty string value causing runtime error - changed to '__none__' placeholder
Excel tab correctly positioned between 'Kategorie opcji' and 'Dane klienta'
Models section shows all Balia models with editable ID fields and cell dropdowns
Heater variants (Zintegrowany/Zewnętrzny) have separate ID and cell mapping fields
Options section shows all categories with their options and cell mapping
Save functionality works - 'Zapisz wszystko' button saves mapping to database
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - using existing prices data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Excel Mapping tab in Balia admin verified working: 1) Tab visible between 'Kategorie opcji' and 'Dane klienta', 2) Shows Excel template info (22 rows, 34 columns), 3) Models with ID fields and cell dropdowns, 4) Heater variants with separate mappings, 5) Options by category with cell mappings, 6) Save button works with toast confirmation
